get.description:
Retrieves the details of all existing and previous jobs associated with a user.

**Note:** This endpoint only returns jobs that are less than 7 days old.

200.description: Returns a list of jobs with details.

id.description: A string that uniquely identifies the job.

created.description: The date time when the job was created.

updated.description: The date time when the job was last updated.

id.description: A string that uniquely identifies institution.
